goal: Implement draggable, resizable, focus-managed app windows.
summary: Phase 2 — Window Manager completed. The Window component now provides a macOS-style title bar with traffic-light buttons, Liquid Glass styling, and a content slot. Drag and resize interactions use pointer events with viewport bounds checking and jsdom-safe pointer-capture guards. A centralized WindowManagerProvider store manages open/close/minimize/maximize/restore/focus/move/resize state, including incremental z-index focus ordering. WindowManager renders windows from the store and wires all interactions. Integration into App.tsx/Desktop.tsx seeds sample Finder and Safari windows. All 26 tests pass and the production build succeeds; a headless screenshot confirms two overlapping Liquid Glass windows on the Tahoe desktop.
stepSummaries:
1. Create Window component with title bar, close/minimize/maximize buttons, and content slot. [verified]
  2. Add drag and resize interactions with pointer events and bounds checking. [verified]
  3. Implement window state store (open, minimized, maximized, position, size, z-index focus). [verified]
